recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white composition featuring a central question mark silhouette filled with a dense collage of figures and textures, framed by a thick white border and an outer border of chaotic, high-contrast photographic snippets.
coreVisualRelationships: Central icon vs. complex internal texture
Stark white negative space vs. dense black borders
Geometric frame vs. organic photographic collage elements
Micro-scale detail vs. macro-scale icon shape
coreInvariants: Strict binary black and white palette
High-contrast threshold effect on all photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large question mark is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 40% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central question mark acts as the primary anchor, supported by the heavy black outer frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central icon, moves outward to the white negative space, and finally circles the busy photographic border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space between the central icon and the inner border creates a 'breathing room' effect that emphasizes the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure black (icon fill and outer border)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; maximum value contrast (binary black/white).

composition.position: Top center, above the question mark

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used at different scales for metadata and display.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean, neutral, and provides the necessary weight at small sizes.
Readily available and matches the high-contrast, utilitarian feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square composition with a thick black outer border made of high-contrast, threshold-filtered photographic snippets of people and textures. Inside this, place a thick white square frame. In the center of the white area, place a large question mark silhouette filled with a dense, high-contrast black and white collage of faces and scribbles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of small, centered, all-caps sans-serif text in black above the question mark with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the palette strictly black and white?
Are the photographic elements processed with a high-contrast threshold effect?
Is there a clear white border between the central icon and the outer collage border?

adjustableVariables: Density of the collage inside the question mark
Width of the white negative space border
Content of the photographic outer border
Scale of the central question mark
mustRedesign: Specific faces or recognizable individuals in the collage
Specific brand logos or advisory stickers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray tones are present.
Verify the question mark shape is distinct and legible.
Check that the outer border collage does not bleed into the central white area.
Confirm text is small and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Icon Shape] + [High-Contrast Collage Fill] + [White Negative Space Frame] + [High-Contrast Photographic Border] = Stark Monochromatic Aesthetic.
